title: A non-canonical role for the ATAD2 ortholog BDF7 in nucleolar ribosome maturation and amastigote survival in Leishmania mexicana
authors: Jones NG; Trindade JBC; Johnson A; Dowle A; Gabarró R; Calderón F; Wilkinson AJ; Mottram JC
one_liner_zh: 该文研究利什曼原虫ATAD2同源物BDF7在核糖体成熟和生命周期中的作用，虽涉及染色质相关蛋白，但核心非蛋白质-DNA互作建模，且无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract:
ATAD2 is a widely conserved, homohexameric ATPase that, in humans, features a bromodomain tier. It plays a role in chromatin remodelling in embryonic stem and germ cells but is frequently upregulated in many cancers, making its bromodomain an attractive drug target. While ATAD2-like proteins generally modulate nucleosome density to control genome compartmentalization and gene expression across eukaryotes, their precise molecular functions vary. We investigated LmxBDF7, the ATAD2 ortholog in the important human pathogen Leishmania mexicana , the causative agent of cutaneous leishmaniasis. Unlike its human counterpart, the LmxBDF7 bromodomain is predicted to be occluded and non-canonical. BDF7 null mutants were unable to develop into infectious amastigote forms and could not infect macrophages, demonstrating it is essential for lifecycle progression. Chromatin Immunoprecipitation sequencing (ChIP-seq) suggested low affinity for chromatin, aligning with its atypical bromodomain. Instead, Proximity-Biotinylation (XL-BioID) suggested a role in ribosome maturation within the nucleolus. RNA-sequencing (RNA-seq) of the Δ bdf7 mutant revealed widespread disruption of gene expression during growth and differentiation. Crucially, key genes required for amastigote survival, such as ribosomal protein genes and glutamine synthetase, were downregulated. This downregulation was spatially biased, preferentially affecting genes on Chromosome 23. Our combined data suggest that while BDF7 is essential, its functions have diverged from other ATAD2-like factors found in opisthokonts.

Author Summary

ATAD2 is a protein that helps cells balance the number of nucleosomes bound to DNA in the nucleus of a cell. Occurring at important sites or times this provides a helper function that ensures other protein complexes can operate on chromatin effectively. In some cancers ATAD2 is disrupted and therefore is being explored as target for new medicines. Orthologues of ATAD2 have been characterised in mammals and several species of yeast. We have sought to identify if an ATAD2-like protein can be found in the important human pathogen, Leishmania mexicana – which is evolutionary distant from humans and yeast. Indeed, we were able to find an ATAD2-like protein called BDF7. Interestingly, BDF7 has a bromodomain which is predicted to be non-functional in terms of being able to bind histones. We were able to make strains of Leishmania mexicana that lacked BDF7 which were viable, but unable to complete the differentiation step required for infecting macrophages. Intriguingly we found BDF7 had a poor association with chromatin and inhabited a protein neighbourhood defined by factors which facilitate ribosome biogenesis. Lastly, RNA-seq analysis of the cells revealed that those lacking BDF7 were potentially depleted for glutamine synthetase which would prevent them developing into fully functional amastigotes.
abstract_zh:
ATAD2是一种广泛保守的同源六聚体ATP酶，在人类中具有溴结构域层。它在胚胎干细胞和生殖细胞的染色质重塑中发挥作用，但在许多癌症中经常上调，使其溴结构域成为有吸引力的药物靶点。虽然ATAD2样蛋白通常通过调节核小体密度来控制真核生物中的基因组区室化和基因表达，但其精确的分子功能各不相同。我们研究了LmxBDF7，这是重要人类病原体墨西哥利什曼原虫（Leishmania mexicana）中的ATAD2直系同源物，该病原体是皮肤利什曼病的致病因子。与其人类对应物不同，LmxBDF7的溴结构域预计是封闭且非典型的。BDF7缺失突变体无法发育成具有感染性的无鞭毛体形式，也无法感染巨噬细胞，表明其对生命周期进展至关重要。染色质免疫沉淀测序（ChIP-seq）提示其对染色质亲和力低，与其非典型溴结构域一致。相反，邻近生物素化（XL-BioID）提示其在核仁内参与核糖体成熟。对Δbdf7突变体的RNA测序（RNA-seq）揭示了生长和分化过程中基因表达的广泛破坏。关键的是，无鞭毛体生存所需的关键基因，如核糖体蛋白基因和谷氨酰胺合成酶，被下调。这种下调在空间上存在偏差，优先影响23号染色体上的基因。我们的综合数据表明，尽管BDF7是必需的，但其功能已与后口动物中发现的其他ATAD2样因子发生分化。

作者总结

ATAD2是一种帮助细胞平衡细胞核中与DNA结合的核小体数量的蛋白质。在重要位点或时间出现时，它提供辅助功能，确保其他蛋白质复合物能有效作用于染色质。在某些癌症中，ATAD2被破坏，因此正被探索作为新药物的靶点。ATAD2的直系同源物已在哺乳动物和几种酵母物种中得到表征。我们试图确定在重要人类病原体墨西哥利什曼原虫（与人类和酵母在进化上相距甚远）中是否能找到ATAD2样蛋白。确实，我们找到了一种名为BDF7的ATAD2样蛋白。有趣的是，BDF7具有一个预计在结合组蛋白方面无功能的溴结构域。我们成功构建了缺乏BDF7的墨西哥利什曼原虫菌株，这些菌株可存活，但无法完成感染巨噬细胞所需的分化步骤。引人注目的是，我们发现BDF7与染色质的关联较弱，并居住在一个由促进核糖体生物发生的因子定义的蛋白质邻域中。最后，对细胞的RNA-seq分析显示，缺乏BDF7的细胞可能缺乏谷氨酰胺合成酶，这将阻止它们发育成功能完整的无鞭毛体。
